# This file signals LLM/AI bots and search engines that this site is LLM/AI-friendly and ready for future crawling standards.

#
# When a standard emerges, use this file to:
#   - Allow or disallow LLM/AI bots (e.g., GPTBot, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, etc.)
#   - Specify allowed/disallowed paths
#   - Provide contact or policy info for AI/LLM use
#
# Example (future syntax, not currently recognized):
# User-Agent: gptbot
# Disallow: /private/
# Allow: /
# Contact: hello@ph7builder.com
# Policy: /page/main/aipolicy
